description: Cross-references for Gov. Code § 13953 CalVCB timeliness framework

cross_references.title: Gov. Code § 13950 — CalVCB Purpose (liberal construction mandate)
cross_references.relationship: The liberal construction mandate of § 13950 governs interpretation of § 13953 timeliness requirements. Ambiguous timeliness questions are resolved in favor of the applicant.

cross_references.title: Gov. Code § 13955 — Eligibility
cross_references.relationship: A timely application is a prerequisite to eligibility; but if timeliness is disputed, the Board must consider the § 13953 good cause extension before denying on timeliness grounds.

cross_references.title: Gov. Code § 13959 — Hearing and Appeal
cross_references.relationship: A timeliness denial is subject to hearing and appeal under § 13959. The Board's timeliness determination is a legal/factual question reviewable on the record.

cross_references.title: Code of Civil Procedure § 335.1 — Discovery Rule (analogous)
cross_references.relationship: The CalVCB discovery rule in § 13953 is analogous to the civil discovery rule that tolls limitations periods until the plaintiff knew or should have known of the injury. The same policy rationale applies.
